headline: WEEK 10: McCAFFREY DROPS 52.3, PURDY ORDERS AN 83.84-POINT PUBLIC EXECUTION
html:
WEEK 10: McCAFFREY DROPS 52.3, PURDY ORDERS AN 83.84-POINT PUBLIC EXECUTION

Week 10 turned into a fantasy-football demolition derby: Christian McCaffrey detonated for 52.3 points, RoCknCoCk Crashouts posted the league’s best score at 181.82, and Kirkumcised Penix handed Pukakke an 83.84-point beating—the biggest win of the week and less a matchup than an insurance claim.

The weekly median was 156.27. RoCknCoCk Crashouts , Secret service chat, OguguaAnunoby, Kirkumcised Penix, and Chef Boyardee earned median wins. Everyone else ate a median loss, including Chase’n Skattehoes despite winning head-to-head. That is the cruel beauty of median scoring: sometimes you beat your opponent and the league still tells you your shit wasn’t impressive.

Standings note: The records referenced below are the supplied current Sleeper standings and may postdate this Week 10 recap. Six teams make the playoffs, which begin in Week 15.

1. CMC PUTS THE LEAGUE LEADER THROUGH A WOOD CHIPPER — RoCknCoCk Crashouts 181.82, alexvandeusen 126.98

Winner: RoCknCoCk Crashouts by 54.84 points. Christian McCaffrey produced the week’s nuclear event: 52.3 fantasy points on 62 rushing yards and a touchdown plus four catches for 161 yards and two more scores. Dak Prescott added 35.42 with 343 passing yards and five touchdowns, while Amon-Ra St. Brown supplied 28.8 on four catches, 98 yards, and two touchdowns. This was not roster construction. This was assembling a fucking orbital cannon.

alexvandeusen received strong work from Nico Collins (24.4; nine catches, 94 yards, one touchdown), Tony Pollard (23.9; 99 scrimmage yards, eight receptions, one touchdown), and the Minnesota defense (21.0; eight sacks, three takeaways, 10 points allowed). Unfortunately, Tyler Shough managed only 10.98 while Jared Goff’s eligible QB ass sat on the bench with 25.42 after throwing for 303 yards and three touchdowns. That was 14.44 available points flushed directly into the toilet, though even perfect quarterback management would not have stopped this massacre.

RoCknCoCk Crashouts also left Stefon Diggs (20.3) and Ryan Flournoy (19.1) on the bench, yet still led the league in scoring and secured both the head-to-head and median wins. alexvandeusen took two losses for the week despite the supplied current standings showing a league-best 14-6 record. Verdict: CMC arrived with a flamethrower, Dak brought gasoline, and alexvandeusen’s first-place résumé got stapled to the wall as a warning.

Highlight: Christian McCaffrey (52.30 fantasy points) — Player scoring highlight: Christian McCaffrey breaks free for his third TD of the game

2. THE SECRET SERVICE COULDN’T HIDE THIS ASS-WHIPPING — Secret service chat 179.06, OguguaAnunoby 157.52

Winner: Secret service chat by 21.54 points. This was the week’s heavyweight fight, with both teams clearing the 156.27 median. Emmett Johnson led the winner with 35.1 points on 101 rushing yards, six catches, 70 receiving yards, and two receiving touchdowns. Jaxon Smith-Njigba added 34.1 on eight receptions for 171 yards and a score, while Joe Burrow threw for 409 yards and four touchdowns to deliver 33.16.

OguguaAnunoby did not go quietly. Jahmyr Gibbs went berserk for 44.2 with 153 rushing yards, 99 receiving yards, and two touchdowns. Isaiah Likely erupted for 30.7 on nine catches, 127 yards, and a touchdown. But Drake Maye contributed only 3.02, completing three of four passes for 48 yards. When your quarterback scores fewer points than some people spend on gas-station nachos, surviving a 179-point opponent becomes difficult.

Secret service chat even survived two lineup land mines: DeMario Douglas scored 1.4 in a FLEX slot while eligible WR Jordyn Tyson posted 19.0 on the bench. That substitution represented 17.6 available points and would have turned a strong win into a full cavity search. Instead, both teams banked median wins, while Secret service chat claimed the head-to-head result and strengthened a supplied current 12-8 position against a 13-7 contender. Verdict: OguguaAnunoby scored enough to bully most of the league; Secret service chat simply showed up carrying three separate sledgehammers.

Highlight: Jahmyr Gibbs (44.20 fantasy points) — Game coverage (individual scoring clip unavailable): ESPN game coverage

3. PURDY GOOD? NO, PURDY FUCKING MERCILESS — Kirkumcised Penix 175.22, Pukakke 91.38

Winner: Kirkumcised Penix by 83.84 points—the biggest win of Week 10. Brock Purdy posted 37.66 points with 389 passing yards, three touchdowns, and 21 rushing yards. Deebo Samuel Sr. added 28.9 through 78 rushing yards, 31 receiving yards, and two total touchdowns. James Cook III ripped off 157 rushing yards and a score for 24.7, while CeeDee Lamb supplied 20.2. Every time Pukakke looked up, another starter was kicking dirt onto the coffin.

Pukakke’s Blake Corum offered resistance with 20.9 on 100 rushing yards, 19 receiving yards, and a touchdown. Kirk Cousins added 16.38 with 207 yards, two scores, and one interception. Then the floor collapsed: Sam LaPorta scored 2.6, Tyler Allgeier scored 1.4, and Omar Cooper Jr. delivered 0.0. Eligible WR Caleb Douglas scored 10.1 on the bench, making the Cooper decision a clean 10.1-point lineup leak.

Kirkumcised Penix earned the head-to-head and median wins, and its supplied current record stands at 13-7. Pukakke lost both and sits at 3-17 in the supplied current standings, with the league’s lowest points total. Verdict: This was not a close loss, a bad bounce, or “one of those weeks.” This was 83.84 points of hard evidence submitted to the fantasy crimes lab.

Highlight: Brock Purdy (37.66 fantasy points) — Player scoring highlight: Brock Purdy scrambles, eventually finds CMC for thrilling 74-yard TD

4. CHEF BOYARDEE OPENS A THREE-TOUCHDOWN CAN OF PICKENS — Chef Boyardee 172.98, I didnt hear no bell 155.02

Winner: Chef Boyardee by 17.96 points—the closest game of Week 10. George Pickens was the head chef with 43.5 points, catching 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns. Parker Washington added 28.2 on seven catches for 152 yards and a score, while Trevor Lawrence supplied 27.78 with 352 passing yards and three touchdowns. Bhayshul Tuten’s 20.3 gave the lineup enough meat to survive weak outings from Tyler Warren (2.4) and Kyren Williams (5.2).

I didnt hear no bell threw a legitimate counterpunch. Patrick Mahomes scored 36.42 after passing for 348 yards and five touchdowns. Chuba Hubbard delivered 34.2 with 172 scrimmage yards and two rushing touchdowns, and Chase Brown added 28.3 with eight catches and two receiving scores. Even kicker Cam Little hung 19.0. Then Jalen Coker scored 0.3 and Corey Kiner managed 2.5, turning two lineup spots into decorative cup holders.

Eligible WR Konata Mumpfield scored 11.1 on the bench and could have replaced Coker, recovering 10.8 points, but that still would have left I didnt hear no bell short. Chef Boyardee earned both the head-to-head and median wins; I didnt hear no bell lost both because 155.02 missed the median by 1.25 points. That is one brutal little kick in the ass. Verdict: Chef Boyardee survived the week’s closest game because Pickens cooked a gourmet meal while Coker brought an empty paper plate.

Highlight: George Pickens (43.50 fantasy points) — Game coverage (individual scoring clip unavailable): ESPN game coverage

5. CHASE’N SKATTEHOES WINS THE GAME, LOSES THE MEDIAN, CONFUSES THE HELL OUT OF EVERYONE — Chase’n Skattehoes 139.14, arupert12 88.84

Winner: Chase’n Skattehoes by 50.30 points. Ja’Marr Chase dominated for 34.1 points on 11 receptions and 231 yards. Cam Skattebo added 27.2 with 78 rushing yards, 44 receiving yards, and two touchdowns, while C.J. Stroud contributed 21.44 through 211 passing yards and three scores. Bijan Robinson chipped in 17.7. The top of the lineup handled business; the bottom mostly tried not to trip over the extension cords.

arupert12 received 24.34 from Josh Allen, including two rushing touchdowns, plus 16.4 from Justin Jefferson and 12.3 from Jonathan Taylor. Then Xavier Worthy scored 0.0 on three targets while eligible WR Josh Downs sat on the bench with 15.3 after four catches, 53 yards, and a touchdown. That was a full 15.3-point bench blunder. It would not have erased a 50.30-point deficit, but it would have made the corpse look less disrespectfully arranged.

Chase’n Skattehoes won head-to-head but finished below the 156.27 median, producing a 1-1 weekly split. arupert12 lost both, scored the league’s fewest points in Week 10, and fell to a supplied current record of 8-12. Verdict: Chase’n Skattehoes won comfortably enough to celebrate, but the median immediately leaned through the doorway and said, “Not so fast, asshole.”

Highlight: Ja'Marr Chase (34.10 fantasy points) — Game coverage (individual scoring clip unavailable): ESPN game coverage

WEEK 10 SCOREBOARD LANDMARKS

  • Biggest win: Kirkumcised Penix over Pukakke by 83.84.
  • Closest game: Chef Boyardee over I didnt hear no bell by 17.96.
  • Highest team score: RoCknCoCk Crashouts with 181.82.
  • Lowest team score: arupert12 with 88.84.
  • Weekly median: 156.27.
  • Head-to-head and median winners: RoCknCoCk Crashouts , Secret service chat, Kirkumcised Penix, and Chef Boyardee.
  • Head-to-head winner but median loser: Chase’n Skattehoes.
  • Median winner despite head-to-head loss: OguguaAnunoby.

POWER METER SUMMARY

OguguaAnunoby remains No. 1 with a 92 power score because the league-best season scoring and supplied current 13-7 record still carry weight, even after losing a 157.52-point shootout. Kirkumcised Penix sits directly behind at 90 after a 175.22-point annihilation. The gap between “favorite” and “guy actively driving a bulldozer” is getting thin.

alexvandeusen remains third at 86 on the strength of the supplied current 14-6 record, but Week 10 was a momentum enema. RoCknCoCk Crashouts and Secret service chat round out the top five after scoring 181.82 and 179.06, respectively. That middle contender tier has stopped politely knocking and started kicking the damn door.

FRAUD WATCH

alexvandeusen: The supplied current standings say 14-6, but Week 10 delivered a 54.84-point head-to-head loss, a median loss, and a starting-quarterback decision that left 14.44 points available. Still a contender, absolutely—but the league leader just got pantsed under stadium lighting.

arupert12: Josh Allen, Justin Jefferson, Jonathan Taylor, and Tee Higgins should not combine into an 88.84-point team score without somebody checking whether the lineup was assembled in a moving elevator. The No. 9 power ranking is not slander; it is documentation.

STOCK UP

  • RoCknCoCk Crashouts : League-high 181.82, powered by McCaffrey’s 52.3 and Dak’s 35.42.
  • Secret service chat: Three starters above 33 points and a win over the official No. 1 power-ranked team.
  • Chef Boyardee: A 7-13 supplied current record looks ugly, but 172.98 points and a dual win are signs of life—not pretty life, but life.
  • Kirkumcised Penix: Balanced scoring, 175.22 points, and the week’s largest victory margin.

STOCK DOWN

  • Pukakke: A 91.38-point week, an 83.84-point loss, and a supplied current 3-17 record. The stock is no longer down; it has tunneled into the Earth’s mantle.
  • arupert12: Week-low 88.84 and Josh Downs’ 15.3 points watching Worthy’s zero from the bench.
  • I didnt hear no bell: Scored 155.02, lost by 17.96, and missed the median by 1.25. A three-course meal of close-but-fucked.
  • alexvandeusen: First in the supplied current standings, third in the official power rankings, and thoroughly vaporized in Week 10.

OFFICIAL WEEK 10 SHITSHOW AWARDS

  • Player of the Week — Christian McCaffrey, RoCknCoCk Crashouts : 52.3 points from 223 scrimmage yards, four receptions, and three touchdowns. He scored more than half of arupert12’s entire lineup total by himself, which is disgusting in the most beautiful possible way.
  • Team of the Week — RoCknCoCk Crashouts : 181.82 points, the week’s highest score, with four starters above 20 points. Even the bench had receivers throwing up 20.3 and 19.1 like the roster was showing off at a family reunion.
  • Biggest Disaster — Pukakke: 91.38 points and an 83.84-point loss. When the margin nearly equals your entire score, the recap stops being analysis and becomes an autopsy.
  • Closest-Game Survivor — Chef Boyardee: Beat I didnt hear no bell by 17.96, the week’s narrowest margin, behind George Pickens’ 43.5-point eruption.
  • Lineup Crime — arupert12: Xavier Worthy scored 0.0 in a FLEX slot while eligible WR Josh Downs scored 15.3 on the bench. The loss was too large for one swap to fix, but this was still fantasy malpractice with fingerprints all over the weapon.
  • Honorable Bench Blunder — Secret service chat: DeMario Douglas scored 1.4 in a FLEX while eligible WR Jordyn Tyson scored 19.0 on the bench. Winning by 21.54 does not make the decision smart; it merely means the rest of the lineup posted bail.

FINAL WORD FROM SBF NETWORK

The supplied current standings show alexvandeusen at 14-6, OguguaAnunoby and Kirkumcised Penix at 13-7, and Secret service chat plus RoCknCoCk Crashouts at 12-8. With six playoff spots and the postseason beginning in Week 15, that leaves a five-team upper class fighting over position while Chase’n Skattehoes and I didnt hear no bell sit at 9-11, arupert12 at 8-12, and Chef Boyardee at 7-13 trying to claw toward the final seat.

Week 10’s message was simple: records are useful, power rankings are official, and then McCaffrey scores 52.3 and turns all your carefully organized bullshit into confetti. Next week, the contenders need to prove these explosions were sustainable, the bubble teams need every head-to-head and median result they can steal, and Pukakke needs to begin by scoring more than the opponent’s margin of victory. Commissioner’s ruling: set your lineup, check your FLEX, and stop leaving double-digit points on the bench like you’re donating to a charity for dumbasses.
